sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Contractive feeling above eyebrows. Dull
heavy, stupid, with foul tongue. Vertigo, with ten-
dency to fall forward. Burning and pressure in eyes.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Taste bitter Aversion to salt meat. Ap-
petite small ; tongue furred ; nausea ; vomiting of green,
acid fluid. Stitches in left side of stomach, near spleen.
[Ceanoth.]


205

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain in region of liver. Left lobe very
sensitive. Fullness and soreness, with moist skin. Con-
stipation; stools hard, difficult, knotty; alternates with
diarrhoea. Stools bright yellow. Swelling of gall blad-
der with painful tenderness. Hyperaemia of liver, with
jaundice. Cirrhosis, with dropsy.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Stitching pains in lower right ribs and front ;
worse, moving, walking, etc. Asthmatic rcsphation.
Pain in chest, going to shoulders, back, loins, and ab-
domen, with urging to urinate.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching on lying down at night. Varicose
ulcers. [Clematis zntalba.] Eruption on lower part of
sternum.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in hip-joint, spreading through
buttocks; zm'osc from stooping. Difficult rising.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Card, bcncdictus (strong
action on eyes, and sensation of contraction in many
parts; stomach symptoms similar); Chelidon.; Chionan-
i/ies; Merc.; Podophyl.; Bry.; Aloe.

sections.label: stomach

deep breathing.

Pleuritis ; chronic bronchial catarrh; phthisis; haemoptysis;

Drawing pain in region of heart, with oppression on deep in-

Drawing pain on margin 1. rib, with pain during breathing,

Stitching pain extending breadth of a hand over right nipple,

Stitches at margin of lower ribs, between both mammary lines,

Stitches during inspiration, between mammary and axillary

Drawing pain through r. pectoral muscle-

Stitches from 1. nipple to r. and downward, lasting several

Stitches in r. side, near the seventh rib, on deep inspiration

I I Continual drawing pain in 1. side of chest, extending to

Pressure in nape of neck.

Pain in shoulder-joint on raising r. arm.

Rheumatic pain in shoulder, radiating from neck.

Pressure in shoulders.

Drawing pain in r. upper arm.

Pains in r. arm are at times so violent that groaning cannot

I I Tearing in 1. upper arm.

Burning pain in skin, on inner side of lower half of 1. fore-

Cramp-like pain in muscles covering 1. radius.

Pressure in wrist-joints.

Cramp-like, drawing pains, in inner side of r. hand, extend-

Burning pain on outer surface of 1. index-finger, in skin.

Rheumatic, drawing sensation, in first joint of fourth finger on

Rheumatic, drawing sensation, in first joint of r. index-finger.

Drawing pain in fourth finger of r. hand, on outer side.

Cramp-like pain in fingers of 1. hand, lasting for ten minutes.

I I Cramp-like pain in second, third and fourth fingers of r.
hand, on outer side.

^^ Lower Limbs. llPain in hip-joints, spreading through but-
tocks, causing difficulty in arising, < from stooping.
Bruised pain in buttocks and legs.
TrDrawing pain in r. thigh.
Drawing pain in skin on outer side of 1. knee.
1 I Drawing pain in 1. knee joint.

Stiffness in knees while walking, of patella and in tendons of
popliteal space, with sensation of lameness in lower parts of
thighs, causing unsteady and stumbling gait.
I I Sensation of coldness in knees.

Pain in hollow of knees while walking, more especially in left.
Sensation while walking as of a band around calves, or of

pantaloons being too tight a few inches below knee.
Drawing pain in superficial nerves, below patella on outer

side of lower thigh, over a space of four fingers in breadth.
Drawing pain from outer side of knees to outer malleolus.
Drawing pain from inner side of lower thigh, to inner malleolus.
Drawing pain from 1. knee into lower thigh.
Paralyzing pain in 1. tibia.
I I Cramp-like pain in calves.
I I Pain in dorsum of r. foot.

I 1 Sudden, cramp-like pain, in muscles of sole of r. foot, flex-
ing the toes; after disappearance of same, intense itching
in front of heel.
Pain on lower part of r. heel, < from walking.
I I Sensation of coldness in toes and soles of feet.
Sciatica.

Rheumatism and spasms of the extremities.
Varicose ulcers.
CEdema of the feetr.
^* Limbs in General. I l Lassitude in arms and legs in morning

after rising, not > by walking in open air.
^^ Rest. Position. Motion. Sitting : drawing pain in bladder.
Stooping: stitches in r. side and over r. nipple; in hip-joints.
Arising : difficult, pain in hip-joints.
Raising arm : stitching pain over r. nipple.
Walking : almost impossible, with pains in chest ; stiffness of
knees ; pain in hollow of knee ; as if a band around calves ;
pain in heel.
Motion : of arm, pains extend over entire front of chest.
Every sudden or violent movement of body is painful, both in

3s Nerves. ■ General feeling of discomfort, lassitude and malaise.
I i Great fatigue after eating, and fatigue with frequent yawn-

2^ Sleep. I Restless sleep, with frequent awakening and many

Lying on back produces nightmare.

CARDUUS MARIANUS. 382

1 I Fatigue about 4 p.m., with sleep while riding, lasting ten

I I Great fatigue with frequent yawning.

I I On awakening, great fatigue with disinclination to rise. '

Uncontrollable yawning in quick succession.

Irritation to cough, felt behind larynx on awakening, with
chilliness.
^^ Time. Night : dry, hacking cough ; itching of skin.

Morning: lassitude of arms and legs.

4 P.M. : fatigue with sleep while riding.

All day: pressure of stomach, with eructation of air.
^^Temperature and Weather. Cold: great sensitiveness- of

the head.
^•^ Fever. llEpidemic affection (see chest and stomach) lasting
seven weeks, was lessened to a few days; the longest seven
days.

I Gastric, catarrhal, or rheumatic fever, with pain in stomach
and region of liver, increased by pressing on it ; symptoms
frequent in epidemic influenza.

I I Chilliness on awakening, with strong urging to urinate.

Chill, with pulse increased from 75 to 90.

Chill, with sensation of a pulse beat in abdomen.

Chilliness at night, < by uncovering; pulse in morning 82.

General sweating and lassitude on awakening.

Sweating of forehead and back after meals.

Right: in eye, pain; auricle, pain; nostril, burning; under

tion; nipple, stitching pain; pectoral region, drawing pain;

pain ; shoulder-blade, drawing pain ; shoulder-joint, pains ;
in deltoid, violent pain ; in arm, violent pains ; in radius,

Left to right : drawing pain through pit of stomach ; stitches
in nipples.
^^ Sensations. As if eyeballs were pressed against side of orbits ;
as though palate were covered with fat.

Stitches : in scrobiculum ; in stomach ; hepatic region ; re-
gion of spleen; hypochondrium; small intestine; near sixth
rib, 1. side ; over r. nipple.

Cutting : in bowels.

Colicky pains : in stomach.

Tearing : 1. upper arm.

Rheumatic pains : in shoulder ; fourth finger, 1. hand ; r. in-
dex-finger.

Drawing pain : in teeth ; through pit of stomach ; hepetic re-
gion ; about umbilicus; through r. inguinal region; in
bladder ; in inguinal region ; in testicles ; in vagina ; mar-

Burning : in eyeballs ; edges of upper lids ; in nostril ; in

Pressure : in forehead ; in eyeballs ; in eyelids ; hepatic re-

Tensive pressure : in scalp ; pain in liver.

Pain : in stomach ; violent in abdomen ; in hip-joints ; in

Cramp-like: muscles 1. radius; inner side r. hand; in fingers;

Motion : in intestines.

CARDUUS MARIANUS— CASCARILLA. 384

Dryness : in palate and lips ; in larynx.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Slight duluess of the head. — Dulness of the head, the whole
day. — Occasionally transitory headache in the forehead and temples. — A
dull headache in the forehead might have been referred to some catarrhal
affection, but no catarrh followed (fourteenth day).

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Tongue coated white in the middle ; red at the tip and edges.
— Accumulation of saliva in the mouth, after taking coffee and milk, half
an hour after the first dose. — Bitterness in the mouth after the dose.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Appetite small. — Loss of appetite. — [10.] Empty eructa-
tions, after food taken against inclination. — Nausea and inclination to
vomit. — Some nausea immediately after the morning dose, repeated after
every subsequent one, and ending in a feeling of inflation in the stomach ; a
horseback ride of three hours in the afternoon increased the inflated feeling
of the abdomen. — Very decided nausea after the first dose, which compelled
me to take the remaining three each in a wineglassful of water, which
moderated the symptom very much. — Great nausea, but no vomiting. —
Violent nausea (very soon after). — Such severe and persistent nausea that
I was obliged to produce vomiting by means of warm water and tickling

i

636


the fauces. — Painful retching and vomiting of acid, green fluid (after ten
minutes). — Increased sensation of uneasiness in the epigastric region, but
no pain. — Pains in the stomach, lasting two hours, aggravated by bread
and mil'k ; meat-broth sat well at noon. — [20.] Painful griping in the
stomach and cutting in the bowels, here and there, with rumbling.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
The feeling of fulness in the^hypochondrium became less
after stool, but was still perceptible enough, obliging me to draw a long
breath. — The feeling of inflation in the abdomen was so strong, especially
in the right side, that I expected to discover a great enlargement of the
liver by percussion, but it was not so ; but pressure was painful over the
whole hepatic region.

Mectam and Anus. — No stool, but inclination to one.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Stool at 8 a.m., of moderate size, pappy, loamy, destitute of
bilious coloring (twenty-second day). — The morning evacuation was harder
than usual. — A hard stool at 9 p.m. ; formerly it took place between 7 and
8 a.m., and was rather pappy. — At 10 a.m. a hard scanty stool ; at 11 a
copious pappy one, but little colored by bile, more of a chocolate color,
preceded by violent rumbliug, with pains in the abdomen. — A very hard
evacuation at a quarter to 9 ; a similar one, unsatisfactory, at a quarter
before 7 p.m. — A very hard, unsatisfactory, difficult evacuation of brown
knotty faeces, immediately after dinner. — [30.] Unsatisfactory, hard, loamy
stool at 6 P.M. — No stool (seventeenth, nineteenth, twentieth, and twenty-
third days).

Urinary Organs. — Urine scanty, brownish ; two experiments, both
with syrup and sulphuric and nitric acids, indicated the presence of the
coloring .matter of the bile in the urine. — Urine cloudy, without sediment,
golden-yellow, acid. — Urine wheyey, yellowish-brown, diminished in quantity,
acid (twentieth day) ; the next day the same, but after standing from six
to eight hours, it deposited a sediment, consisting chiefly of common salt
and lime ; experiments with solution of sugar and sulphuric acid gave
traces of the coloring matter of the bile in the urine.

Respiratory Organs. — Frequent urging to deep breathing, fol-
lowed by painful sensations of an undefined sort in the abdomen.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Every sudden and violent movement of the body was painful,
both in the chest and abdomen.

General Symptoms. — Great debility all day.

Sleep and Dreams. — Restless at night, with frequent waking;
lying on the back produced nightmare, which woke me twice. — Restless,
dreamy night.

Conditions. — Aggravation. — (Bread and milk), Pains in stomach. —
(After coffee with milk), Accumulation of saliva. — (Lying on back), Pro-
duced nightmare. — (Riding on horseback), Inflated feeling of abdomen.

Amelioration. — (After stool), Feeling of inflation of abdomen.

END OF VOLUME II.

sections.label: tongue
sections.text:
Tongue has white center with red, indented edges. Vomits acrid bile or blood. High
diaphragm. Liver engorged; swelled laterally. Gall-stones (Lept.). Meteorism. Knotty, clayey
stools. Golden yellow urine. Asthma. Dropsy. Broken or hard thrombosed veins.
